data.title: Memphis
data.tagline: Use bold geometry, pattern, and asymmetry for an energetic composition
data.description: Memphis design uses geometric shapes, dots, squiggles, contrasting color, and playful imbalance. On the web it works best as a controlled visual language around clear content. Filling every gap with shapes makes the page harder to read and weakens the style's rhythm.

use: Children's or education product after user testing
avoid: Cover dense work interfaces in constant pattern
Place dots and shapes over reading or click targets
Mix a soft palette with heavy outlines without a reason
Let decoration overpower reports, contracts, or key facts
